value.rationale: The first nonlinear augmentation layer is the canonical boundary where regular-module pi-point rigidity ceases. The theorem classifies an unbounded natural family of all Jordan partitions plus exact arithmetic frequencies, including transverse higher-order singularity distinctions invisible to the quadratic Hessian; it is more than a low-parameter numeric calculation.
